Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

FOREWORD 

This amendment is bring issued to transfer the requirements in 
respect of the nominal count of basic yarn and threads per decimetre 
to Table 1 since these are the particulars meant as a guide to the 
manufacturers.

renumber the existing Si No. * (iii), (iv), (v) and (vi) ' as

b) Delete the Note.

IS: 7610 (Part II) -1975 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
MACHINERY FABRICS, WOOL 

PART 11 CLEARER CLOTH 
0. FOREWORD 

0,1 This Indian Standard ( Part II) was adopted by the Indian Standards 
Institution on 28 February 1975, after the draft finalized by the Wool 
and Wool Products Sectional Committee had been approved by the 
Textile Division Council. 

0.2 Clearer cloth is a plain or twill woven fabric made of wool fibres only 
or blends of wool and man-made fibres At least one surface of the fabric 
is raised which gives a short and dense nep. 

0.3 A series of standards are being formulated on machinery fabrics, 
Part I of which covers the general requirements and other particulars 
regarding marking, packaging, sampling and criteria for conformity of 
machinery fabrics. Since this part covers the requirements of clearer 
cloth, IS : 6054-1970* is being withdrawn. 

0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS:2-l960t. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this 
standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1-1 This standard ( Part II ) prescribes the manufacturing particulars and 
other requirements of clearer cloth. 

2- MANUFACTURING PARTICULARS 

2*1 The manufacturing particulars of clearer cloth are given in Table 1. 

•Specification for clearer cloth. 

fRules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ).

3. RETIREMENTS 

3.1 The clearer cloth shall conform to the requirements given in Table 2 
in addition to complying with the stipulations laid down in Part I of 
the standard. 

3.2 The clearer cloth shall be tested for the various characteristics by 
the methods specified in Part I of the standard.
